name: Bazarr+ Subtitles
description: Connect to a self-hosted Bazarr+ server to search and download subtitles across all configured providers via a single endpoint. Requires a Bazarr+ v2.2.0+ instance with the External Integration endpoint enabled.
overview: Fetch subtitles from a Bazarr+ instance via the OpenSubtitles-compatible REST endpoint

versions.changelog:
- Setup docs and the settings page now point at the Distribution Hub in Bazarr+ v2.4.0 and later, with the older steps kept for v2.2.x and v2.3.x
- Search sends the file name and season/episode with the IMDb id so Bazarr+ can score by release match; results show the score, uploader and subtitle file name
- Malformed login tokens no longer break search; the plugin signs in again instead
- Query values keep their case (for example zh-CN), and the API key is no longer sent to external download links
- Release workflow and build fixes

- Initial fork from jellyfin-plugin-opensubtitles
- Retargeted at Bazarr+ compat endpoint
- Independent reimplementation of OpenSubtitles REST protocol
